question: Who were our top 3 clients by net booked value in Q3 2026?
sql: SELECT a.account_name, sum(b.amount) AS net_booked_value FROM bookings b JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id = b.opportunity_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE b.status = 'active' AND b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY a.account_name ORDER BY net_booked_value DESC LIMIT 3;
